tasks.title: Move bake-off into its own folder, separate from the real project
tasks.notes: Goal: one distinct top-level folder in the main repo (e.g. bakeoff/) holding everything bake-off, so it cannot be mixed up with real world/tool work. Today it is scattered: model-bakeoffs/ (PROTOCOL, README, catalogue, config, packs, rounds, checks), scripts/model_bakeoff.py + test_model_bakeoff.py + feature_selection_check.py, skill .claude/skills/model-bakeoff, docs/model-bakeoffs.md, and the world checkout worlds/bakeoff (gitignored, own git repo). References to update: AGENTS.md, docs/active-world-contract.md, docs/audits/region-block-reads.md, rules/build-roles.md, scripts/run_tests.py, scripts/stale_terms_audit.py, tasks/done.json notes, the round JSONs (R-006..R-013), checks/feature-selection scenarios, and the 'refuse unless active world is bakeoff' guards in model_bakeoff.py. Open decisions: (1) does the bakeoff world checkout also move into the new folder or stay under worlds/ (active_world.py / AI_WORLDBUILDER_WORLD_ROOT expectations); (2) bake-off gets its own reference data (OSM vector_map clips etc.) so it never reads southampton-build; this absorbs #95; (3) shared code (feature_build, site_kit, world_frame) stays in scripts/ and is imported, not copied. Done when: nothing bake-off lives outside the folder except shared tool code, grep finds no stale paths, scripts/run_tests.py passes, `model_bakeoff.py status` works from the new location, and the R-014 record notes the move. Do not move mid-sitting: finish or park R-014 first. Ship via task/* branch.
